common.takeBreakBody: You've played for a while. A short break can help.
common.clinicalNote: SmritiSetu supports cognitive engagement and helps families track changes over time. It is not a diagnosis. Please consult a doctor for medical advice.

roles.choosePrompt: Who is using SmritiSetu right now?

onboarding.chooseLanguageBody: Tap the language you are most comfortable with.
onboarding.consentBody: SmritiSetu stores everything about the patient — their name, games played, and progress — only on this device. Nothing leaves this device unless you choose to sync it.
onboarding.consentPointStorage: All data stays on this device by default, even without internet.
onboarding.consentPointControl: You can export or permanently erase all data anytime from the Admin Panel.
onboarding.consentPointNotDiagnosis: SmritiSetu supports cognitive engagement — it is not a medical diagnosis.
onboarding.setupCaregiverPin: Create a 4-digit PIN for caregiver login
onboarding.setupCompleteBody: SmritiSetu is ready to use, even without internet.

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.body: SmritiSetu ran into a problem. No data was lost — you can go back and try again.

caregiverAuth.title: Caregiver Login
caregiverAuth.wrongPin: That PIN doesn't match. Try again.
caregiverAuth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}}s.
caregiverAuth.scanQr: Or scan your caregiver QR code
caregiverAuth.forgotPinBody: There's no PIN recovery on this device, so anyone who can open this screen can set a new PIN directly — this has always been a lightweight gate to keep patients out of caregiver screens, not a real security boundary.
caregiverAuth.forgotPinNoAccount: No account was found on this device.

adminAuth.title: Admin Login
adminAuth.wrongPin: That PIN doesn't match. Try again.

adminPanel.noPatients: No patients yet on this device.
adminPanel.noCaregivers: No caregivers yet on this device.
adminPanel.resetAllDataBody: This permanently erases all data on this device. Type "{{word}}" to continue.

levelSelect.title: Choose a Level
levelSelect.body: Nothing is locked — pick any level to play. SmritiSetu still picks one automatically for everyday play.

patientHome.todaysSetBody: Three games picked just for today
patientHome.moreGamesBody: Pick anything you like. Nothing is timed.

reminders.title: Today
reminders.noneToday: Nothing scheduled right now. Well done!
reminders.allDoneCount: All {{total}} done. Nothing else is needed today.
reminders.label: What is it for?
reminders.scanFailed: Couldn't read the label. Try a clearer, well-lit photo, or type it in.
reminders.labelRequired: Enter what this reminder is for

familyManager.title: Family & Faces
familyManager.body: Add photos, names and voice notes for Naam Yaad.
familyManager.name: Name
familyManager.removeMemberBody: This deletes {{name}}'s photo{{voice}} and removes them from Naam Yaad. This cannot be undone.

dashboard.title: Caregiver Dashboard
dashboard.gardenGrowthBody: The plant grows a stage for every week with 3 or more days of play — a simple, calming way to see steady effort build up over time.
dashboard.domainBalanceBody: How evenly {{name}} is playing across all 5 areas
dashboard.suggestion: {{domain}} games have had the least practice recently. Try opening one together.
dashboard.suggestionTied: Several kinds of games have had equally little practice recently. Try opening a different one together.
dashboard.cognitiveInsightsBody: A statistical trend line per domain, computed from this patient's own sessions — not a two-point comparison, and never compared against anyone else's data.
dashboard.shareWithFamilyBody: Anyone with this link can view a read-only snapshot of this week's progress — no login needed. It doesn't update after you send it; generate a new one for a fresh snapshot.
dashboard.disclaimer: This dashboard shows trends to discuss with a doctor. It is not a diagnosis or a medical device.
dashboard.noData: Not enough data yet — play a few games first.
dashboard.reminderAlertsBody: Get an alert on this device when it's time for medicine, water, or an activity — works while SmritiSetu is open, even in the background. It can't wake a fully closed browser tab.
dashboard.reminderAlertsOn: Alerts are on for this device
dashboard.reminderAlertsDenied: Permission was blocked. Enable notifications for this site in your browser or device settings to turn this on.
dashboard.privacyDataBody: Manage what SmritiSetu has stored for this patient.
dashboard.deletePatientDataBody: This permanently deletes every game session, level, reminder, reminder history, and family member (including photos and voice notes) saved for {{name}}. This cannot be undone.

sharedView.banner: You're viewing a read-only snapshot a family member shared. It won't update, and this device isn't signed in as a caregiver.
sharedView.invalid: This link looks broken or was altered. Ask for a fresh one.

orientationCheckin.whatTime: What time of day is it?

smriti-cards.name: Smriti Cards
smriti-cards.instructions: Tap two cards to find matching pairs. Try to remember where each picture is.
smriti-cards.clinicalMapping: Maps to delayed recall (MoCA) and word recognition (ADAS-Cog) through visual pair matching.
smriti-cards.coachIdle: Tap any card to begin. Nothing here is timed.
smriti-cards.coachMiss: Not a pair this time — that is perfectly fine.
smriti-cards.coachMissFollowup: Take your time and try another card.
smriti-cards.coachComplete: All pairs found. That was lovely work, {{name}}.

smriti-katha.name: Smriti Katha
smriti-katha.instructions: Listen to a short story, then answer simple questions about it by picking a picture.
smriti-katha.clinicalMapping: Maps to episodic and verbal recall (MoCA delayed recall; ADAS-Cog word recall) using an everyday spoken story instead of a word list.

naam-yaad.name: Naam Yaad
naam-yaad.instructions: A photo of someone you know will appear. Tap their correct name.
naam-yaad.clinicalMapping: Maps to personally-meaningful recognition memory (MoCA/ADAS-Cog recall & recognition), using the patient's real family photos.

dhyan-dhaam.name: Dhyan Dhaam
dhyan-dhaam.instructions: Tap every tile that matches the target pattern shown at the top.
dhyan-dhaam.clinicalMapping: Maps to sustained visual attention and cancellation tasks (MoCA attention; ADAS-Cog number cancellation).

ginti-dhyan.name: Ginti Dhyan
ginti-dhyan.instructions: Tap the numbers in counting order, smallest first.
ginti-dhyan.clinicalMapping: Maps to attention and working memory (MoCA digit span and serial subtraction), at an elderly-accessible pace.

awaaz-pehchan.name: Awaaz Pehchan
awaaz-pehchan.instructions: Listen carefully. Tap the button only when you hear the target word or sound.
awaaz-pehchan.clinicalMapping: Maps to sustained auditory attention (MoCA attention/vigilance), fully audio-driven for patients with limited reading ability.

dinacharya-sequence.name: Dinacharya Sequence
dinacharya-sequence.instructions: Drag the picture cards into the order you do them each day.
dinacharya-sequence.clinicalMapping: Maps to instrumental activities of daily living (IADL) planning and sequencing.

bazaar-list.name: Bazaar List
bazaar-list.instructions: Listen to the shopping list, then find only those items in the grid.
bazaar-list.clinicalMapping: Maps to prospective memory and IADL planning, similar to everyday errand-list recall.

ghar-ka-kaam.name: Ghar ka Kaam
ghar-ka-kaam.instructions: Tap a household tool, then tap the task it is used for.
ghar-ka-kaam.clinicalMapping: Maps to routine-object association, a common early sign area in IADL assessment.

aakar-milan.name: Aakar Milan
aakar-milan.instructions: Find the piece that completes the pattern correctly.
aakar-milan.clinicalMapping: Maps to visuospatial and executive function (MoCA visuospatial/executive; ADAS-Cog constructional praxis).

chaya-khoj.name: Chaya Khoj
chaya-khoj.instructions: Look at the object, then tap its matching shadow.
chaya-khoj.clinicalMapping: Maps to visuospatial matching (MoCA visuospatial), with no reading required.

naksha-jodo.name: Naksha Jodo
naksha-jodo.instructions: Drag the large pieces together to build the picture. Take your time.
naksha-jodo.clinicalMapping: Maps to constructional praxis (ADAS-Cog), a gentler analogue of the clock-drawing/figure-copy task.

aaj-ka-din.name: Aaj Ka Din
aaj-ka-din.instructions: Answer a few simple questions about today.
aaj-ka-din.clinicalMapping: Maps to temporal and spatial orientation (MoCA orientation subtest). A daily check-in, not a difficulty drill.

ghadi-dekho.name: Ghadi Dekho
ghadi-dekho.instructions: Look at the clock, then tap the time it shows.
ghadi-dekho.clinicalMapping: Maps to visuospatial and temporal orientation (MoCA visuospatial/executive) — a close analogue of the Clock Drawing Test used in dementia screening worldwide.
